explore.title: Beyond the River Calchaquí
explore.hint: Move the pointer. Hover over elements to inspect. Click to interact.

battle.title: Rhythm duel
battle.tutorial_hint: Play the notes! (←/→ to align with the tab lane)

narrative.rock_hover: A smooth stone by the path.
narrative.rock_inspect: A smooth stone, polished by the wind. There are carved marks you cannot decipher.
narrative.tree_inspect: A dry algarrobo. Its shade shelters stones someone stacked with care.
narrative.ruin_inspect: Adobe walls that time brought down. Someone lived here; now only dust remains.
narrative.coquena_hover: A hunched figure by the fire.
narrative.coquena_inspect: Coquena, the merchant and protector deity. Watches you without haste.
narrative.guitar_hover: A forgotten guitar among the stones.
narrative.guitar_inspect: An old guitar, strings nearly intact. Someone left it here.
narrative.guitar_inspect_have: You already have the guitar. Strings hum in the wind.
narrative.guitar_desc: An old guitar found on the riverbank.
narrative.guitar_pickup: You picked up an old guitar. Might be useful later.
narrative.relic_hover: A stone carved with ancient symbols.
narrative.relic_inspect: A stone relic with a symbol you do not recognize. It radiates warmth.
narrative.relic_inspect_have: You already have the relic. Coquena might be interested.
narrative.relic_pickup: You picked up a carved relic. Warm to the touch.
narrative.ucumar_hover: A dark, hairy figure blocks the path.
narrative.ucumar_inspect: The Ucumar. It guards this path. The magic of the Pacha protects you… for now.

coquena_greeting.l1_coquena: You came far, little one. The river is not crossed with hunger, but with wit.
coquena_greeting.l2_acay: I came… from the other side of the river. My village is starving.
coquena_greeting.l3_coquena: I do not understand you, but I know you. The spirit that guides you… is also familiar to me.
coquena_greeting.l4_acay: How do I cross? The river is swollen…
coquena_greeting.l5_coquena: If you wish to cross, you will need more than courage. Search the riverbank.

pacha_greeting.l1: Fear not, little one. The land hears you, though you cannot see it.
pacha_greeting.l2: You cross the river seeking riches… but what you need is here, on the bank.
pacha_greeting.l3: Gather what the water left behind. Each stone tells a story.
pacha_greeting.l4: When you have enough, return to me. I will guide you.

pacha_relics.l1: I see you found relics. Ancient stones hold memory.
pacha_relics.l2: The Ucumar blocks the path… but your heart is brave. Approach when you are ready.
pacha_relics.l3: Remember: you must not strike, you must dodge. Force is not your path.

scene01.acay_unconscious_hover: A boy lies unconscious on the shore.
scene01.acay_line: I must cross the river, I cannot fail this time.
scene01.voice_line: Find a way to cross the river safely.
scene01.rocks_inspect: If I could push this rock maybe I could cross.
scene01.objective_push_rocks: Find a way to push the rocks
scene01.left_exit_1: I can't go back home, not yet, I need to cross the river, there I'll surely find something.
scene01.left_exit_2: I know it's dangerous but I must try, I can't go back empty-handed.
scene01.right_exit_hover: The trail continues to the right.

scene02.river_inspect_long: The Calchaquí river, provider of life, protector of the mountains, descends from the heavens to us... or so my teacher says.
scene02.gaucho_hover: A gaucho sleeping under the cardón.
scene02.gaucho_sleeping: He sleeps deeply, hat over his face.
scene02.gaucho_l1: What's up kid? Cross the river?
scene02.gaucho_l3: Can't you wait till tomorrow when it goes down?
scene02.cardon_inspect: A century-old cardón. Its shade shelters the sleeping gaucho.
scene02.blocked_gaucho: Better talk to the gaucho first.
scene02.kettle_acay: Might be useful, and if not at least I can make some mate.
scene02.wood_gaucho: Didn't use it all, take it easy, tomorrow I'm heading to the northern town, I'll get more on the way.
scene02.wood_acay: They're heavy, but when I put them in my bag they suddenly weigh nothing... Thanks Pacha.
scene02.poncho_desc: My poncho. Keeps me warm and safe.
scene02.gaucho_stop_1: Wait kid, before you go, what's your name?
scene02.gaucho_stop_3: Acay huh? What a cool name. Well Acay, before you leave this town to its fate, let me give you a blessing, and let's play something together.
scene02.exit_blocked_gaucho: Better not leave yet. The gaucho told me to wait.
scene02.gaucho_warning: Good kid, but inside you'll see amazing and dreadful things. There are many like me, and some won't be as nice.
scene02.duende_intro: Now then kid, show me what you're made of.
scene02.duende_reward: Nice one kid, maybe I'll help before I leave tomorrow, if you manage to cross the river. Here.
scene02.vara_desc: A sturdy iron rod. Useful for leverage.
scene02.exit_blocked_no_gaucho: I shouldn't leave without talking to the gaucho first.
scene02.exit_blocked_right_no_gaucho: I don't know what's here. Better talk to the gaucho.
scene02.exit_blocked_quest_done_left: I already crossed the river once. The camp is behind me.
scene02.exit_blocked_quest_done_right: The river is on the other side. I must go back and cross.
scene02.gaucho_return: Forgot something? Take the wood and go.

scene04.vara_use: I did it, but it's too unstable, I can't step on it without falling, but at least the river went down a bit.
scene04.unstable_rock_hover: A wobbling rock in the current.
scene04.unstable_rock_inspect: The rock moves. I need something to stabilize the crossing.
scene04.exit_right_no_rocks: I need to find a way to cross the river.
scene04.exit_right_no_bridge: The rock is in the river, but I need something to make a bridge.
scene04.exit_right_bridge_ready: The bridge is ready! I should cross there.
